payload.name: HVAC School Guide
payload.description: Free public training-cost vs pay report from an independent education publisher for people comparing skilled-trade training options; may support career planning and employment-resource discovery. Not a direct service provider.

payload.name: CareClinic Health Tracker
payload.description: CareClinic is a free personal health journal for recording symptoms, medications, mood, sleep, routines, and appointments in one place. It helps people and caregivers keep an organized record over time and prepare shareable summaries for conversations with clinicians. It is a self-management and organization tool and does not diagnose conditions or replace professional care.

payload.name: TypeOut
payload.description: TypeOut is a typing-based AAC app for iPhone. Type, and your phone speaks in the voice you choose; when someone replies, their words appear in large text. Make it your own with 12 interface styles, your own photos as backgrounds, colored phrase buttons, eight AI voices, plus your own custom voice. For teens and adults. Free to download; the built-in iPhone voice is free forever, and cloud-based AI voices require a subscription.

payload.name: ABA at Home
payload.description: ABA at Home is a family-support app created for parents and caregivers of autistic children. It provides practical tools families can use during everyday life at home, including communication supports, visual routines, Daily Lessons, Help Now, Safety Hub, toilet training support, printable activities, caregiver resources, and support for challenging moments. Families can also use Multi-Caregiver Sync, Care Team Chat, and Saved Lessons to help parents, caregivers, and invited members of their care team stay connected. ABA at Home is available nationwide on iOS and Android. Core features are available free, with an optional Pro subscription for additional features.

payload.name: Special Needs Jobs
payload.description:
Hi there,

I'm Kyle, and I run Special Needs Jobs over at specialneedsjobs.org. It's a free job board for ABA therapy roles across the US: BCBAs, RBTs, and behavior technicians, with pay, location, and work setting on each listing, plus free job alerts by email.

I was looking through your resources page and thought we could be a helpful addition for your readers. Would you consider adding us?

Thanks for the work you do,
Kyle

payload.name: Premium AFO Socks | Coolest Knee-High Socks – LAIROS
payload.description: We don’t just make socks - we fix what regular socks get wrong. Lairos socks are designed to fit braces perfectly, stay comfortable all day, and look like something kids actually want to wear.

payload.name: tta1
payload.description: tta1 is a text-to-speech reading aid. It helps students, people with dyslexia or low vision, and anyone who prefers listening by reading articles, PDFs and documents aloud in a natural voice, with translation into 25 languages. Freemium: free to try with 1,000 words a month; Plus from $6/mo.

payload.name: MedicaidWorkCheck.com
payload.description: MedicaidWorkCheck.com is an independent, plain-English information site about the new federal Medicaid work requirement. Free tools include an 8-question exemption checker that becomes a private 80-hour monthly work tracker (no sign-up; all data stays in the visitor's browser), plain-English guides to every exemption category, 51 state-by-state guides, a living lawsuit tracker, and a full Spanish-language section.

payload.name: Xi's
payload.description:
Xi's is a free, independent adaptive-clothing discovery website. People describe their dressing needs, including mobility, dexterity, comfort, access or style, and explore clothing options. No account is needed. It is not a retailer or a clinical assessment. Product availability, sizing, shipping and medical-device compatibility should be checked with the official retailer before buying.
https://wearablexi.app/
